data.explanation: This letter confirms a scheduled eye examination following your ophthalmologist's referral. Attend at the stated time and register on the 2nd floor. Your pupils will be dilated during the exam, so you will not be able to drive yourself afterwards for a few hours — arrange for someone to accompany you or use public transport. Bring your glasses and a list of your current medications. If you cannot attend, contact the clinic to reschedule.
